native_mechanisms: Each byte is folded into one never-empty cup and the cup's new colour seeds the next byte, so the whole buffer passes as one unbroken serial chain
The final accumulator colour is carried through seven successive organs, each bending it against a shifted view of itself and discarding half of what it received
Flip one bit anywhere in the buffer, re-run the whole pour from the start, and condemn the method if the new token resembles the old
core_technique: Byte-at-a-time serial accumulator hash (xor byte, multiply by odd 64-bit constant, rotate) seeded with 2^64/phi, length-appended, then a 7-round xor-shift-multiply finalizer — i.e. FNV-1a/xxHash-style single-accumulator folding with a Murmur3-style avalanche tail.
